paragraphs: Envirosight makes inspection equipment for the pipes that carry sewage and stormwater underground. That equipment is sold to cities and to the contractors who do the same work for them.

The core of the line is a wheeled camera crawler built for the conditions of underground work. Specialty crawlers and attachments fit the same platform, so one system can be adapted to different pipe sizes and inspection types. Operators code what they see at the controller using standard defect catalogs. Finished inspections, including video and images, upload to a web service for sharing and storage.

The company states that more than four thousand of these crawler systems operate worldwide. Alongside the hardware it publishes material for the market, including whitepapers, webinars, blog posts, infographics and case studies.

quote.text: Sewers demand constant work. Your inspection equipment shouldn’t.
